text.arabic_uthmani: بَلْ ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَنقَلِبَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِيهِمْ أَبَدًۭا وَزُيِّنَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَظَنَنتُمْ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًۢا بُورًۭا

words.gloss_range: corrective particle; it replaces the prior explanatory surface with the accusation that follows
words.prose: The particle opens as correction rather than continuation. It displaces the excuse-frame from 48:11 and turns the address toward the inner assumption that will be traced through the whole ayah.

topics.headline: corrective opening replaces the excuse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah begin as a second rebuttal, moving from the excuse in 48:11 into direct exposure of the hidden assumption.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: perfect second-person cognition verb; locally a settled assumption taking a full content clause
words.root_gloss_range: cognition, supposition, and opinion ranging from doubt toward confidence; here narrowed by the later evil-assumption label to blameworthy settled conjecture
words.prose: The first verb makes the concealed cognition a completed second-person act, not a vague fear. Its object is the full embedded claim that the messenger and believers would not return, while the later evil-assumption phrase in this ayah selects the blameworthy pole of the root.

topics.headline: completed direct accusation with a full content clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the hidden thought treated as a completed, directly attributable act whose content is the whole non-return proposition.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: content particle introducing the object-clause of the assumption
words.prose: This particle turns the following denial into the content of the first assumption. The structure places conjecture outside and emphatic future negation inside, so the certainty belongs to the accused cognition rather than to reality.

topics.headline: the non-return claim becomes assumed content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the future denial is grammatically packaged as what they assumed, not stated as an independent fact.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: emphatic future negator governing the return verb
words.prose: The negator makes the imagined return a denied future before the time-adverb seals it. Its force is not mere hesitation about outcome; with the later perpetual adverb, the assumption becomes a claim of no return at all.

topics.headline: future negation hardened by permanent time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the assumption denied return categorically across the future, especially once the closing time-adverb arrives.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive Form VII return verb; destination phrase selects return-to-family over broader reversal or apostasy readings
words.root_gloss_range: turning, overturning, return, and heart-related turning; here the destination phrase selects homeward return while preserving a local heart-root echo
words.prose: The verb is held under future negation, so the return exists in the sentence as the event they ruled out. The destination phrase narrows the q-l-b range to homeward return rather than apostasy-type reversal, while the later heart word repeats the same root and makes outward turning-back meet inward turning.

topics.headline: Form VII return narrowed by destination and echoed in hearts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denied event as a self-involving homeward return, while the same q-l-b root later makes that outward return collide with the inward hearts.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative subject; the known messenger as mission-bearing return-subject
words.root_gloss_range: sending and mission-bearing; here the definite role noun identifies the known messenger as the return-subject, not a generic envoy
words.prose: The definite nominative names the known messenger as subject of the return that the doubters deemed impossible. The role noun keeps mission and dispatch in view, and the following conjunction binds his imagined fate to the believers rather than leaving him isolated.

topics.headline: the known messenger is inside the denied return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied return concerns the known mission-bearing messenger as the first half of a joint subject, not an anonymous traveler.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle joining the two nominative subjects
words.prose: This connector makes the messenger and believers share one grammatical fate under the return verb. It is light in form but decisive in scope: the denied return applies to both together.

topics.headline: the connector binds messenger and believers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the believers joined as equal subjects of the same denied return rather than added as an afterthought.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative active participle plural; a known believing group coordinated as return-subject
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, and committed belief; here the active participle names the believers as a known agentive group under the denied-return assumption
words.prose: The nominative plural completes the compound subject of the denied return. Its active-participle form keeps committed trust and security in view, making the false assumption sharper because the safety-root group is imagined as never reaching home.

topics.headline: believers complete the compound return-subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the believers as a known, agentive trust-bearing group whose return is denied alongside the messenger.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition governing the family destination
words.prose: The preposition supplies the endpoint that the return verb needs here. It steers the q-l-b motion toward families and away from other inqilāb patterns such as turning back against something in 2:143 or 3:144.

topics.headline: direction selects homeward return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition turns q-l-b into movement toward a family endpoint, not a free reversal.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: genitive possessed family phrase; collective family/belonging endpoint of the returning party
words.root_gloss_range: family, household, belonging, familiarity, and worthiness; here narrowed to the families or belonging-places of the messenger-believer party
words.prose: The suffix points back to the messenger and believers, so the destination is their families, not the addressees’ families. The word carries household and belonging, and it reverses the previous family claim in 48:11 by making family not the excuse for absence but the homeward endpoint they thought others would never regain.

topics.headline: their families are the denied endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the destination as the messenger-believer party’s own belonging-place, reversing the family excuse voiced in 48:11.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: accusative time adverb of perpetuity reinforcing the negated return
words.root_gloss_range: unbroken duration and perpetuity; here functioning as an adverb that seals the negated future as permanent in the false assumption
words.prose: The time-adverb closes the non-return unit by stretching the negation into unbroken duration. It makes the false cognition overreach: not just danger, delay, or uncertainty, but a future imagined with no return-point at all.

topics.headline: perpetuity seals the first beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first movement close on permanence, so the assumption becomes total denial rather than temporary pessimism.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle pivoting from assumption-content to beautification mechanism
words.prose: This connector restarts the chain after the permanent-denial close. It does not formally say because, but it places the beautification clause beside the assumption so the reader moves from content to mechanism.

topics.headline: the connector moves from content to mechanism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah shift from what they assumed to how that assumption became attractive inside them.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: perfect passive Form II; produced beautification of the prior assumption with suppressed agent
words.root_gloss_range: beauty, adornment, and making something appear fair; here passive Form II narrows it to produced attractiveness of a false thought
words.prose: The passive Form II presents the assumption’s appeal as produced, not inherent. The agent is withheld, while the beauty-root turns the false non-return scenario into something made to seem fair, a pointed irony because the same act is later named evil assumption.

topics.headline: false cognition is made attractive by a hidden agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the false assumption as manufactured attractiveness: made fair in the hearts while the beautifying agent remains unspoken.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: demonstrative pronoun referring back to the entire non-return assumption
words.prose: The demonstrative does not point to one nearby noun. It compresses the whole non-return proposition into a definite object, then lets that object serve as what was made attractive in the passive clause.

topics.headline: the whole assumption becomes the thing beautified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a whole proposition compressed into a single demonstrative so it can become the patient of beautification.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition governing the heart phrase as interior arena
words.prose: The preposition locates the beautification inside the hearts. It makes the mechanism interior: the ayah is not merely reporting an external argument but identifying where the false scenario became attractive.

topics.headline: beautification is located inside the hearts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the mechanism placed inside the addressees’ hearts rather than on the public surface of persuasion.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: possessed broken plural heart noun; inner cognitive-affective site of beautified false assumption
words.root_gloss_range: turning, heart, core, intellect, emotion, and will; here the plural possessed hearts are the interior site of beautified false cognition
words.prose: The possessed plural makes the inner site directly theirs and collectively distributed. The heart is the decision-center, not just an organ, and its q-l-b root answers the earlier return verb: the outward turning-back they denied is echoed in the inward turning-place where denial was beautified.

topics.headline: their plural hearts become the site of adorned delusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the addressed hearts as plural decision-centers and as the q-l-b root partner of the return they denied.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle linking beautification to explicit diagnosis
words.prose: This connector keeps the chain moving from inner mechanism to named diagnosis. The following repeated cognition verb is not redundant; it returns to the act so the next words can classify it.

topics.headline: the connector turns mechanism into label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated assumption is cumulative: after mechanism comes the moral label of the act.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: second perfect second-person cognition verb; repeated form now governing a cognate accusative
words.root_gloss_range: cognition, supposition, and opinion; here the repeated perfect verb shifts from content-report to moral diagnosis through a cognate accusative
words.prose: The repeated verb brings the addressees back as grammatical subjects after the passive clause. Its complement has changed: no longer a full content clause, it now governs a cognate accusative, so the ayah transforms what they assumed into the kind of assumption they made.

topics.headline: the repeated verb shifts from content to classification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same verb return after beautification to restore responsibility and recast the first assumption as a diagnosed act.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: verbal noun as cognate accusative and construct head before the evil qualifier
words.root_gloss_range: cognition and conjecture as a nominalized act; here the verbal noun is bound in construct to the evil qualifier
words.prose: The verbal noun turns assuming into a thing that can be classified. As a cognate accusative it intensifies the repeated verb, and as construct head it binds the act to the evil qualifier, aligning the diagnosis with the same phrase used in 48:6.

topics.headline: the act is reified as an evil-assumption formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the cognition turned into a named object that can be bound to the evil qualifier and linked with the formula in 48:6.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive evil/badness noun qualifying the assumption in construct
words.root_gloss_range: evil, badness, harm, corruption, and ugliness; here the definite genitive noun classifies the assumption as the recognized evil kind
words.prose: The genitive qualifier grammatically defines the assumption rather than floating as a separate comment. Its field includes evil, harm, corruption, and ugliness, and in Surah 48 it connects this diagnosis with 48:5 and the evil-assumption formula of 48:6.

topics.headline: the assumption is defined as the evil kind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the final qualifier morally and aesthetically classifies the cognition as a recognized evil-assumption category, not just an inaccurate prediction.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle introducing the final state-verdict clause
words.prose: The connector does not state a formal consequence, but it places the verdict immediately after the evil-assumption label. The movement is from diagnosis into classification: what they thought now lands as what they were.

topics.headline: the final connector moves diagnosis into verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final characterization arrive as the culmination of the evil-assumption diagnosis, even without an explicit therefore.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: perfect second-person kāna; establishes an already-settled predicate condition
words.root_gloss_range: being, existence, and state; here perfect second-person plural kāna establishes an already-settled condition before the verdict phrase
words.prose: The verb does not introduce a fresh action; it assigns an established condition. Its second-person ending keeps the accusation direct, and its predicate frame opens the same verdict pattern known from 25:18, adapted here into direct address.

topics.headline: kāna opens an established identity judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing phrase as a settled state-verdict in direct address, with the rare formula also appearing in 25:18.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative people-noun as kāna predicate; communal type awaiting its qualifier
words.root_gloss_range: standing, communal body, and peoplehood; here an indefinite accusative predicate classifies the addressees as a kind of people
words.prose: The noun serves as the accusative predicate of the state-verb, so the clause classifies the addressees as a people-type. Its indefiniteness generalizes the condition, and the standing/communal force of the root is deliberately exposed to the final word that will ruin it.

topics.headline: the group is classified as a kind of people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees individual false assumptions converted into a communal type, with the standing sense of peoplehood set up for ruin to negate.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative adjective or second predicate of barren ruin and worthlessness
words.root_gloss_range: perishing, barrenness, waste, nullity, and worthlessness; here the final adjective/predicate makes the group a people of barren ruin
words.prose: The final word locks the ruin-quality onto the people noun and may also be heard as an added predication. Its root field brings perishing, fallow land, nullity, and unsaleable worthlessness into the closure, so the accusation ends with a rare image of a people who yield no value, a formula also shared with 25:18.

topics.headline: barren ruin is the final verdict-word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah close on a rare, concrete image of barren worthlessness: a people like land or goods that yield no value.
topics.reason: The surviving CRITICAL rows converge on this local function, and the attachment or lexical guardrails support it without forcing rejection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three ظ ن ن occurrences at words 2, 15, and 16 surround the passive beautification and culminate in ظن السوء at word 17.
baseline_models.mechanism: A weakly grounded forecast about an untrusted outcome is made attractive inside the heart, then returns as apparent certainty and a total evil judgment. The cognate repetition makes the error recursive: supposition is not merely held but reinforced by its own internally improved appearance.

activation_trace.role: Weak-sign supposition supplies the unstable starting estimate that the expedition will not return.
An outcome whose end cannot be trusted supplies the unresolved risk that the speakers convert into permanence.
Certainty formed after an indication marks the hardened endpoint of the repeated supposition.
Making something appear good supplies the feedback operation that improves the forecast's felt plausibility.
Intrinsic ugliness supplies the moral quality of the final judgment despite its beautified presentation.

changed_reading.before: They made a pessimistic prediction and were condemned for it.
changed_reading.after: They ran an epistemic feedback loop in which fragile risk became attractive, attractiveness became evidence, and repeated supposition hardened into an evil certainty.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ق ل ب appears both in يَنقَلِبَ at word 5 and قُلُوبِكُمْ at word 14.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same root binds the denied outward return to the inward organ of judgment. The speakers deny that bodies can turn homeward while their own inner core has already turned the signs away from their proper face; the external no-return is generated by an internal reversal.

activation_trace.role: Return and destination supply the outward motion whose possibility the speakers deny.
The heart as understanding supplies the inner site where the denied outward turn is modeled.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies the distortion that converts ambiguous signs into a one-way outcome.
Displayed improvement supplies the finishing operation by which the inward reversal feels coherent.

changed_reading.before: Return and hearts are two unrelated uses of the same root.
changed_reading.after: The verse makes the denied outer turn a product of an inner turning: the heart reverses the evidentiary face of the journey and then declares homecoming impossible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The forecast joins return to families, permanence, and the closing description قَوْمًا بُورًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers imagine the believers' households permanently emptied by non-return. The close then redirects that spatial image: vacancy and barrenness do not finally characterize the absent families but the forecasters' own collective state.

activation_trace.role: Kin and household belonging supply the social space imagined as deprived of its returning members.
Unending duration stretches the imagined household loss into a permanent condition.
An emptied, desolate dwelling materializes what 'never returning to their families' would do to domestic space.
Barren, vacant land returns the projected emptiness onto the people who made the forecast.
Coming to be in time makes the redirected barrenness a realized identity, not merely an insult.

changed_reading.before: They expected permanent deaths abroad and are then called ruined.
changed_reading.after: They project permanent vacancy onto the believers' homes, but the sentence turns that vacancy back onto them as their own barren social condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The copular close وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًا بُورًا names a collective and predicates bُور of it.
baseline_models.mechanism: Risk avoidance preserves the group physically but arrests its capacity to rise, act, and circulate value. A named people remains standing in place while stagnation proceeds toward corruption; survival purchased by nonparticipation becomes a mode of collective waste.

activation_trace.role: Realized presence in time supplies the transition from a choice to an established condition.
A human collective supplies the social body whose viability is being diagnosed.
Standing still, exhaustion, and stoppage supply the group's arrested mode of self-preservation.
Stagnation that continues into spoilage supplies the causal path from inaction to collective corruption.
Ruin and corruption supply the terminal condition toward which the stagnation tends.

changed_reading.before: قَوْمًا بُورًا is a generic denunciation of doomed people.
changed_reading.after: It diagnoses a collective that remains present by refusing costly movement, yet becomes socially nonproductive and spoils through its own stoppage.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dispatched Messenger and the trust-defined believers form the compound subject of the denied return to their sphere of belonging.
baseline_models.mechanism: The forecast imagines public mission as a one-way severance from domestic belonging. Dispatch, trust, and family reintegration cannot coexist in the forecasters' model, so being sent outward is treated as exile rather than a movement capable of return.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch and outward release supply the mission's movement away from home.
The carrier and carried message supply the public purpose that the forecast collapses into the traveler's fate.
Trusting assent supplies the followers' defining relation to the Messenger and his message.
Return to a destination supplies the missing second half of the imagined one-way dispatch.
The near circle of kin and belonging supplies the social destination from which mission is falsely severed.

changed_reading.before: The sentence simply predicts that two groups of travelers will die.
changed_reading.after: It exposes an imagination in which being sent for a trusted public purpose can only end in permanent exile from ordinary belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denied homeward turn is bracketed by an accomplished opening at the start of the surah and a later counterfactual in which the adversaries are the ones who turn their backs. Direction is reassigned: the Messenger's outward movement opens victory, while failed retreat belongs to the opposing force.

activation_trace.role: Homeward return supplies the motion that the focus forecast declares permanently unavailable.
An opening into victory supplies the actual outcome of the journey misread as terminal loss.
Turning one's back in retreat transfers irreversible outbound motion from the believers to their opponents.

structural_cues: 48:1 states an accomplished opening before the focus, while 48:22 assigns bodily turning-away to the opposing side.
The focus's لن ... أبدا is therefore held inside a sequence that redistributes who turns, who returns, and what the departure produces.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed motion and outcome images; I infer a directional chiasm in which the forecasters assign terminal motion to the wrong party. The live alternative is that the opening and enemy retreat are separate assurances without a deliberate lexical answer to ينقلب.

changed_reading.before: The speakers merely underestimate the travelers' chance of survival.
changed_reading.after: They map direction backward: the Messenger's departure is an opening that permits return, while the terminal turning-away they imagine for him is assigned to the adversary.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the packet, hearts are not neutral containers. Tranquility comes to believing hearts, zeal is placed in rejecting hearts, and the focus's no-return model is beautified in the stayers' hearts. The focus therefore depicts a rival heart-formation: an attractive internal stabilization that imitates settled confidence while carrying a false outcome.

activation_trace.role: The heart as understanding supplies the shared interior site in which distinct dispositions take hold.
Making the forecast look good supplies the counterfeit mode by which it settles inwardly.
Cessation of agitation supplies the genuine settling placed in believing hearts.
Known heart-content supplies the contrasting interior that is answered with tranquility rather than beautified conjecture.
Proud heat and anger supply another disposition explicitly installed in hearts, clarifying the heart as a contested causal site.
Settled stillness supplies the counterforce placed upon the Messenger and believers.

structural_cues: The packet repeats heart constructions at 48:4, 48:11, 48:12, 48:18, and 48:26.
Different predicates govern those interiors: tranquility descends, zeal is placed, and the fatal forecast is beautified.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies different contents and operations around repeated hearts; I infer rival modes of inward stabilization, with beautification mimicking the felt quiet of confidence. The alternative is a looser thematic contrast in which زُيِّنَ has no formal relation to sakinah.

changed_reading.before: The passive beautification reports generic self-deception.
changed_reading.after: It describes a counterfeit heart-settlement: a pleasing fatalism occupies the same interior site where the packet elsewhere locates tranquility or heated zeal.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 48:11 the stayers put wealth and family on their tongues as the cause of absence, while the verse says their tongues do not match their hearts. The focus then repeats family and heart but supplies the concealed calculation: they expected the Messenger and believers not to return. Family changes from actual impediment to rhetorical cover for a privately advantageous forecast.

activation_trace.role: Family belonging supplies the repeated term whose function shifts from excuse to object of the concealed prediction.
Accusatory suspicion supplies the hostile inner content hidden behind the respectable family claim.
Occupation rather than availability supplies the overt causal excuse for staying behind.
Kin and household supply the socially credible cover named by the stayers.
The speech organ supplies the external channel explicitly separated from inward content.
The heart as understanding supplies the concealed layer that the focus immediately reconstructs.

structural_cues: 48:11 immediately precedes the focus and contrasts tongue with heart.
The sequence repeats أهل from the excuse and قلب from the concealment, then places the no-return scenario inside that heart.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, repeated family and heart language, and an explicit mouth-heart mismatch; I infer that 48:12 discloses the principal hidden rationale. The live alternative is that 48:11's hidden content is broader insincerity and 48:12 gives only one component of it.

changed_reading.before: The no-return belief is an independent mistaken prediction.
changed_reading.after: It is the concealed calculation behind a family-centered alibi: domestic duty is spoken, while inwardly the speakers expect the committed party to disappear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah speaks of not believing in God and His Messenger. That adjacency activates the accusatory and hostile branches of repeated supposition: the no-return model is not only poor risk analysis but an implicit charge that the Messenger's dispatch and message cannot be trusted.

activation_trace.role: Suspicion as accusation supplies the forecast's tacit indictment of the Messenger's undertaking.
Hostile suspicion supplies the relational antagonism carried by what first looks like detached pessimism.
Trusting assent supplies the relation whose absence makes the no-return story plausible to the stayers.
The message-bearing envoy supplies the object against which the failed trust is directed.

structural_cues: 48:13 follows the focus with the construction ومن لم يؤمن بالله ورسوله.
The focus itself names both الرسول and المؤمنون inside the rejected-return scenario.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate adjacency and repeated Messenger-belief terms; I infer that the general warning classifies the preceding posture as a trust failure. The alternative is that 48:13 broadens beyond the stayers without specifically redescribing their forecast.

changed_reading.before: Their error is emotionally pessimistic but relationally neutral.
changed_reading.after: Their forecast functions as a tacit accusation against the reliability of the sent message and therefore as failed trust, not merely fear.

context_deltas.mechanism: When the journey appears lethal, the stayers are certain there will be no return; when gains become available, the same group asks to follow. The changing payout reveals the earlier certainty as motivated cognition: danger was amplified and beautified when it justified nonparticipation, then mobility reappeared when acquisition was visible.

activation_trace.role: An untrusted outcome supplies the uncertainty selectively resolved toward fatal loss when participation is costly.
Making the preferred scenario look good supplies the incentive-sensitive distortion.
Acquiring and winning something supplies the new payoff that reverses the stayers' willingness to move.
Failure of comprehension supplies the packet's diagnosis of their inability to read beyond immediate advantage.

structural_cues: 48:15 names the same المخلفون and has them request inclusion when spoils are the destination.
Their movement preference changes with the visible payoff, while the focus's absolute forecast had presented itself as objective certainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same group's opposite participation choices under different incentives; I infer that expected payoff helps cause the earlier risk judgment. The alternative is sincere fear followed by regret, though the stated lack of understanding keeps motivated cognition live.

changed_reading.after: They manufacture certainty in the direction that protects present advantage, then revise their appetite for movement when gain replaces risk.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus moves from uncertain signs to لن and أبدا, converting a bounded human estimate into universal impossibility. At 48:21, what lies outside human capacity is nevertheless fully encompassed. This exposes the hidden inference: 'we cannot see or secure the route' became 'the return can never occur.'

activation_trace.role: Uncertain estimation supplies the limited evidence from which the absolute conclusion is drawn.
Unending duration supplies the unjustified scale of the conclusion.
Capacity sufficient for action supplies the bounded human ability that the context explicitly says was lacking.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and possession supplies the larger horizon omitted from the focus forecast.

structural_cues: The focus couples لن with أبدا, while 48:21 contrasts لم تقدروا with قد أحاط الله بها.
Both passages move from a human relation to a future outcome toward a claim about that outcome's reach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limited capacity and larger encompassing; I supply the arrow that the stayers projected their own limit onto reality. The alternative is that 48:21 concerns later gains and offers only an analogical epistemic correction.

changed_reading.before: They make a factually wrong absolute prediction.
changed_reading.after: Their deeper error is scale conversion: private incapacity and uncertain access are inflated into an eternal limit on what can happen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus uses أهل for the families to whom return is denied; 48:26 uses the same root for being fit and entitled to the word of protection. Belonging therefore doubles: the believers return to a kin-group, but they are also themselves the qualified people of a binding word. The stayers misread both where the believers belong and what makes a people viable.

activation_trace.role: Family and near belonging supply the physical-social destination allegedly lost forever.
Barrenness supplies the failed collective belonging assigned instead to the forecasters.
Fitness and entitlement supply a second kind of belonging possessed by the Messenger's committed group.
Binding and fastening by a norm supplies the relation that makes them its qualified people.
Fixed entitlement supplies the stated warrant for that ethical belonging.

structural_cues: The exact root ء ه ل occurs in the focus's أهليهم and in 48:26's وأهلها.
48:26 coordinates أحق بها with أهلها after the word is made binding upon the Messenger and believers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two live senses of one root; I infer a contrast between kin belonging and normative qualification. The alternative is ordinary local polysemy with no intended cross-activation.

changed_reading.before: أهليهم only names bereaved families awaiting travelers.
changed_reading.after: The denied homecoming sits inside a wider test of belonging: those predicted to lose their أهل are shown to possess ahliyya, while the forecasters become the barren collective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus offers a self-beautified future image based on supposition; 48:27 offers a dream confirmed in truth, secure entry, and knowledge beyond the audience. The contrast is not optimism versus pessimism but rival warrant structures: one image feeds on its own attractiveness, while the other is tied to truth and fulfilled action.

activation_trace.role: Weakly warranted imagining supplies the false future representation.
A feared bad outcome supplies the affective content that the false representation projects.
Making a promise true in action supplies external confirmation rather than self-confirmation.
A dream-vision supplies the competing future image whose warrant the context explicitly establishes.
Truth fixed in correspondence with reality supplies the vision's grounding.
Secure calm supplies the embodied outcome that directly contradicts permanent non-return.

structural_cues: 48:27 promises entry with emphatic future form and the state آمنين, then says that God knew what the audience did not know.
The focus also concerns an unseen future, but marks its representation as beautified supposition and evil.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two future representations and sharply different warrant terms; I infer an epistemic foil. The alternative is that the confirmed dream addresses timing of sanctuary entry without directly answering the stayers' death forecast.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns pessimism and the context later supplies an optimistic promise.
changed_reading.after: The packet distinguishes self-sealing conjecture from truth-backed vision: valence is secondary to whether the future image has warrant outside its own appeal.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 48:28 the Messenger is again defined through sending, guidance, truth, and the message's prevalence. This reopens the focus's compound subject: the stayers reduce a dispatched mission to whether its carrier completes a round trip, while the packet presents transmission as an outward trajectory whose efficacy exceeds that travel calculation.

activation_trace.role: Being sent outward supplies the movement that the stayers mistake for one-way loss.
Return and destination supply the narrow round-trip measure imposed on the mission.
The envoy and carried message supply a mission identity that cannot be reduced to the carrier's travel risk.
A lived order of obedience supplies the social field into which the message is meant to propagate.
Rising to prevalence supplies the onward result that outlasts the stayers' one-trip model.

structural_cues: 48:28 repeats رسول through the formula هو الذي أرسل رسوله and gives the sending a stated purpose.
The focus binds الرسول to physical return, whereas 48:28 binds him to the outward efficacy of guidance and truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch, message, and prevalence; I infer that the stayers collapse mission efficacy into carrier survival. The alternative is that 48:28 simply restates the Messenger's commission after his safe return.

changed_reading.before: The stayers miscalculate whether the Messenger will complete a dangerous journey.
changed_reading.after: They mistake the mission for a fragile round trip and cannot imagine a sending whose truth-bearing trajectory reorganizes the field through which the carrier travels.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing crop image supplies a complete collective growth sequence: sowing, emerging shoots, mutual strengthening, thickening, and upright load-bearing stalks. Against that sequence, قَوْمًا بُورًا becomes the anti-crop: a group that stays in place to preserve itself but produces neither new growth nor supporting structure and therefore passes from stagnation to barrenness.

activation_trace.role: Stoppage and exhaustion supply the arrested collective posture that the later crop reverses.
Barren empty land supplies the ecological negative against which the closing growth process reads.
Cultivation and growth supply the generative collective process absent from the barren people.
Shoots emerging around an origin supply multiplication without abandonment of the source.
Plants strengthening one another supply mutual support as the engine of collective durability.
Thickening after thinness supplies maturation from vulnerability into resilient substance.
Rising and settling upright supplies stable attainment rather than immobilized stagnation.
The load-bearing stalk supplies the mature structure through which the collective can stand.

structural_cues: The focus closes with a people predicated as بُور, while 48:29 closes the surah with an extended crop-development sequence.
The crop does not merely survive; its parts emerge, support one another, thicken, and stand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical barrenness and an explicit social crop model; I infer a surah-scale counter-image between two kinds of collective persistence. The alternative is that بُور remains generic ruin and the crop independently praises believers.

changed_reading.before: The stayers are doomed, while the believers are later praised with an unrelated crop simile.
changed_reading.after: The stayers are an anti-crop: self-preserving immobility makes them barren, while committed movement generates shoots, support, thickness, and stable collective standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's false outcome is cosmetically improved inside hearts; 48:29 presents a visible mark on faces as the lasting effect of embodied prostration. The contrast creates two evidentiary surfaces: an appearance with no demonstrated cause except beautification, and an appearance that carries the residue of repeated action.

activation_trace.role: Making something look good supplies the unsupported cosmetic plausibility of the no-return story.
The hidden interior supplies the location where the attractive appearance avoids public testing.
A sign from which an observer reads condition supplies the visible and interpretable counter-appearance.
The face as forward visible surface supplies the public location of the mark.
A lasting sign that indicates a prior event supplies the causal residue linking appearance to practice.
The bodily members and effect of prostration supply the action from which the visible sign derives.

structural_cues: 48:12 locates beautification in hearts; 48:29 locates a readable mark on faces and gives it a causal من أثر construction.
Both passages concern how an appearance is produced and then treated as evidence of an inward condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden beautification and a visible action-trace; I infer a contrast of evidentiary provenance. The alternative is that the two appearance complexes are independent and should not be made into a deliberate foil.

changed_reading.before: Beautification simply means that a bad idea felt attractive.
changed_reading.after: Its defect is also evidentiary: it is an inward cosmetic with no tested cause, unlike a visible mark presented as the durable effect of embodied practice.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a material branch of ق ل ب rather than the ordinary heart or return senses. It remains anchored in the root's double occurrence and the passive beautification inside hearts, but downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for cognitive fixation, not as the lexical meaning of قلوب here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ق ل ب joins the denied return and the heart, while زُيِّنَ describes an operation performed within that heart.

activation_trace.role: A mold into which material is poured supplies an image of the heart fixing a fluid possibility into one repeatable scenario.
Applied adornment supplies the finishing layer that makes the molded scenario desirable to retain.
Apparent certainty after a sign supplies the rigid cognitive product that comes out of the mold.

changed_reading.before: A thought is made appealing in the heart.
changed_reading.after: A still-fluid risk estimate is poured into an inner قالب, finished with adornment, and reproduced as a fixed certainty.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a form-distant activation because the surface أبدا ordinarily marks duration while the cited branch concerns a wild or stray word. It remains anchored at the verse's emphatic absolute and the adjacent untrusted-outcome branch of ظ ن ن; render it only as metalinguistic wordplay that diagnoses runaway certainty, never as a replacement translation of أبدا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The emphatic أَبَدًا at word 10 turns a conjecture about an uncertain outcome into unrestricted permanence.

activation_trace.role: A wild, stray word supplies a metalinguistic image for the absolute escaping the limits of its evidence.
An outcome that cannot be trusted supplies the narrow uncertainty from which the verbal absolute runs loose.

changed_reading.before: أبدا merely intensifies how long they expect non-return to last.
changed_reading.after: The very word of permanence can be heard, experimentally, as the forecast's runaway word: an absolute that has gone wild beyond its evidentiary enclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the dominant local force of بُور is ruin or barrenness, not testing. It remains valid as a secondary branch activation attached to the final predicate and the realized-state construction; downstream prose should say the outcome exposes or assays their condition while retaining ruin as the primary sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The close وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًا بُورًا presents بُور as the realized predicate of what the group had become.

activation_trace.role: Testing a thing to discover its condition supplies an assay-image for how the failed forecast reveals the group.
A state coming to be in time supplies the condition made visible by that assay.
Ruin and corruption preserve the dominant result whose exposure the exploratory assay supplements.

changed_reading.before: The ending only announces a fixed verdict of ruin.
changed_reading.after: The journey and its misreading also function as an assay: they disclose in action the ruined collective condition that the final predicate names.

strongest_changes: The adjacency of 48:11 turns family from a genuine cause of absence into the tongue-level alibi for a concealed no-return calculation.
Repeated heart constructions distinguish beautified fatalism from tranquility and heated zeal, making the focus a model of rival inward formations.

48:21, 48:22, and 48:27 expose three errors in the forecast: human incapacity is absolutized, retreat is assigned to the wrong party, and self-confirming supposition is confused with truth-backed vision.
48:26 and 48:29 reopen أهل and بُور as a contrast between qualified belonging and collective barrenness, culminating in the believers' mutually supported crop growth.
The visible action-trace on faces in 48:29 creates a live evidentiary foil to the unsupported cosmetic plausibility installed in hearts at 48:12.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly reuses the focus's own heart, belief, Messenger, family, and collective-state roots, then closes with both a causal visible mark and a full growth mechanism. That structure supports several coexisting readings rather than one harmonized moral: motivated cognition, directional reversal, rival heart formation, contested belonging, epistemic scale error, and ecological nonproductivity.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus leaves the agent and exact process of زُيِّنَ unstated, so the rival-installation model remains abductive rather than syntactically explicit.
The cross-activation between family أهل and qualified أهل may be designed polysemy or only a productive reader-side linkage.
The crop and visible-mark contrasts are strong packet-level mechanisms, but their degree of direct reference back to قَوْمًا بُورًا and زُيِّنَ cannot be forced.
The mold, wild-word, and assay branches should remain visibly exploratory and must not displace the ordinary lexical readings.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A projected non-return becomes an inward reversal.** `ينقلب` anchors ق ل ب B004 (turning/reversing) and B005 (return), while `قلوبكم` anchors B001 and reactivates B004. Repeated `ظننتم` supplies ظ ن ن B003/B005, uncertain and habitual bad suspicion. The same root links forecasted bodily return to actual inward turning. I infer that their projected route reverses their own inner orientation. The failed prediction is also self-description.
2. **Decorated sterility.** `زين` anchors ز ي ن B002/B003, making beauty show and adornment; `بورًا` anchors ب و ر B001 (ruin) and B003 (uncultivated waste). The final crop image of 48:29 later supplies the ecological opposite: supported shoots become thick and upright. I infer that inward beautification conceals failure to produce trustworthy action. Their attractive scenario reads as uncultivated ground rather than insight.
3. **Permanent severance from belonging.** `أهليهم` anchors ء ه ل B001 (people bound by belonging), and `أبدًا` anchors ء ب د B001/B006 (enduring duration; staying and not leaving). The supposition permanently cuts travelers from their households. I infer that the speakers protect their own household attachment by imagining the others’ attachment irrecoverably broken. The excuse’s family concern is exposed as asymmetrical belonging.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 48:29 supplies the sharpest correction through the crop: supported shoots produce thick, upright growth, the inverse of uncultivated `بور`. The decorated heart in 48:12 proves productive only to itself.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A projected non-return generated by inward turning.** Fixed `يَنقَلِبَ` and `قُلُوبِكُمْ` share ق ل ب and activate `B004`, turning and reversing, across an outward verb and an inward noun. Ayah 48:11 has already separated tongue from heart; 48:15 and 48:16 show the same people trying to follow gain yet turning from costly obedience, and 48:17 repeats volitional turning away. The packet supplies these opposed orientations; I infer **an inwardly reversed evaluator -> projection of irreversible outward failure onto others**. The forecast of no return reads as a disclosure of the forecasters' own turned hearts.

2. **Decorated thought on uncultivated ground.** Fixed `زُيِّنَ` anchors ز ي ن `B002`, making beauty show, while `بُورًا` anchors ب و ر `B003`, "waste and uncultivated land." Ayah 48:17, at the forward edge of the window, contrasts this with entered gardens and running water. The packet gives cosmetic display, barren ground, and cultivated enclosure; I infer **surface beautification without truthful cultivation -> a persuasive but fruitless inner model**. `قَوْمًا بُورًا` thus diagnoses failed production, not only destruction.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayat 48:15-17 made the reversal reading behavioral: pursuit appears around gain, withdrawal around cost, and genuine bodily impediment is separately exempted. Ayah 48:17's watered gardens also supplied the productive landscape whose absence makes fixed `بورا` read as uncultivated inner ground.

baseline.text: Hayır, elçinin ve inananların ailelerine asla dönmeyeceklerini sandınız. Bu, kalplerinize güzel gösterildi. Kötü bir zanda bulundunuz ve mahvolmuş bir topluluk oldunuz.

findings.text: Elçinin ve inananların dönmeyeceği yönündeki tahmin, bunu kuran kalplerin kendi iç yön değiştirmesini dışarıya yansıtır.
Kalpte güzel gösterilen senaryo, güvenilir eylem üretemediği için süslü fakat işlenmemiş, verimsiz bir toprağa benzer.
Başkalarının ailelerine dönüşünü sonsuza dek kopmuş saymak, kendi aile bağlılığını korurken karşı tarafın aidiyetini değersizleştiren asimetrik bir tutumdur.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: The Household Horizon of Return
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A household is constituted by expected return; when return is denied, habitation flips into vacancy and staying becomes abandonment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The false prediction does more than anticipate death; it lexically empties the dwelling before the travelers' fate is known.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Inhabited Place of Return
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Kin inhabit a familiar dwelling that remains oriented toward the travelers' return.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: kin and household (`quranic:root_000064:B001/m01`); inhabited familiar place (`quranic:root_000064:B004/m01`); dwelling (`quranic:root_000726:B002/m01`); resident household (`quranic:root_000726:B003/m01`); return or reversal of departure (`quranic:root_001248:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 48:11 `أهلونا` (ء ه ل); 48:12 `ينقلب` and `أهليهم` (ق ل ب; ء ه ل); the dwelling root occurs as `السكينة` at 48:4 (س ك ن).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Household, dwelling, and return form one spatial relation: the family is not only a group but the inhabited terminus toward which movement can reverse. The heart-root's return sense makes the interior judgment about non-return also a directional act.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: The Household Horizon of Return
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A household is constituted by expected return; when return is denied, habitation flips into vacancy and staying becomes abandonment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The false prediction does more than anticipate death; it lexically empties the dwelling before the travelers' fate is known.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Vacancy Produced by Non-return
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Those who remain imagine a permanent absence, converting staying into the production of an empty home.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: empty or abandoned home (`quranic:root_000004:B003/m01`); staying without departure (`quranic:root_000004:B006/m01`); barren or empty dwelling (`quranic:root_000164:B003/m01`); those remaining behind (`quranic:root_000433:B003/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 48:12 `أبدا` and `بورا` (ء ب د; ب و ر); 48:11 `المخلفون` (خ ل ف).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Permanent non-return hollows out the expected destination. The ones who stay behind preserve their own location, but their supposition turns the travelers' households into abandoned space and exposes staying as a morally barren condition.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Voiced Exterior and Reworked Interior
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Speech can present one account outwardly while the heart silently constructs, decorates, and reverses another.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The conflict is not simply speech versus belief; the inner account is an actively edited representation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Decorated Inner Model
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An unvoiced thought is turned into a pleasing internal picture and stabilized as a harmful supposition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: unvoiced inner saying (`quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`); heart as interior center (`quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`); turning or reversing a thing (`quranic:root_001248:B004/m01`); decorating and improving appearance (`quranic:root_000660:B002/m01`); uncertain supposition (`quranic:root_000969:B003/m01`); harmful suspicion (`quranic:root_000969:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 48:11 `قلوبهم` and 48:12 `قلوبكم` (ق ل ب); 48:12 `زين` and `ظننتم` (ز ي ن; ظ ن ن); the saying root occurs at 48:11 as `سيقول` and `يقولون` (ق و ل).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The interior does not merely omit the tongue's claim. It turns the expected outcome, decorates that reversal until it appears plausible, and holds the result as suspicion. The surface lie and the inner model are thus distinct operations.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Adverse judgment closes around its object, expels it from protection, and exposes it to destructive heat.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The sequence spatializes judgment as a tightening circuit followed by removal into an ignited exterior.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Expulsion into an Ignited State
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Wrath removes the object from favor, and the resulting exterior is figured as ruin and sustained ignition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: wrath (`quranic:root_001092:B001/m01`); expulsion from good (`quranic:root_001359:B001/m01`); ruin (`quranic:root_000164:B001/m01`); blazing fire (`quranic:root_000708:B001/m01`); ignition of war or evil (`quranic:root_000708:B002/m01`); furnace pit (`quranic:root_000708:B009/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 48:6 `غضب` and `لعنهم` (غ ض ب; ل ع ن); 48:12 `بورا` (ب و ر); 48:13 `سعيرا` (س ع ر).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Wrath and curse perform the exclusion, ruin names the stripped condition, and the blaze gives that condition a material environment. The furnace image makes destructive consequence an enclosing destination rather than a momentary flash.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin bilinmesi ya da bulunması beklenen yeri, alışılmış bulunduğu alanı veya onu gösteren belirtiyi açıkça aynı kullanım çevresinde toplar. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bu yer ve gösterge anlamını doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Burada anlatılan, düşünme eylemi değil, bir şeyin bulunmasının beklendiği yer ya da göstergedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım mekanik olarak yalın dalı izler ve başka dallardaki özel söz öbeği anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin bulunduğu düşünülen yer, alışılmış olarak bulunduğu alan veya onun varlığını gösteren belirti ya da işarettir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin bulunmasının beklendiği yer veya alışılmış bulunduğu alanı belirtir.
Bir şeyin varlığını ya da bulunduğu yeri gösteren belirti anlamına da gelir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak tanıklık, beklenen bulunma yerini, alışılmış alanı ve gösterici belirtiyi aynı anlam çevresinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyin bulunduğu düşünülen yer veya onu gösteren belirti
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem beklenen bulunma yerini hem de o yeri gösteren belirtiyi kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Beklentiye dayalı yer anlamıyla gösterici belirti anlamını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin olağan olarak bulunduğu ya da aranacağı yer anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Beklenen ve alışılmış bulunma yeri anlamını doğal biçimde korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin nerede bulunduğunu gösteren iz veya belirti öne çıktığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Varlığı ya da yeri gösterme işlevini açıkça korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin içinde bulunduğu herhangi bir yer beklenti koşulu olmadan anlatılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: beklenen bulunma yeri ve genel yer

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal, yeri beklenti, alışkanlık veya gösterge işleviyle niteler; komşu dal ise yalnızca bir şeyin bulunduğu genel yeri bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kesinliğe ulaşmayan düşünmeyi, kuşkuyu ve belirtinin çok zayıf kaldığı durumda kuruntu sınırına inen inanışı açıkça verir. Dalın zayıf ve kesinleşmemiş zihinsel tutum olarak kurulması bu kanıtla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kesin bilgiye ulaşan güçlü inanış, kişiye yöneltilen suçlama ve beklenen yer anlamı bu dalın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın zihinsel tutumu kapsar; özel yapılara bağlı suçlama veya yer anlamı eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şey hakkında kesinliğe ulaşmadan, çoğu kez zayıf bir belirtiye dayanarak edinilen kuşkulu inanıştır; belirti iyice zayıfladığında kuruntu düzeyine iner.

facets.statement: Kişi bir şey hakkında kesin bilgiye ulaşmadan kuşkulu bir inanış taşır.
Dayanak olan belirti çok zayıfsa inanış kuruntu sınırını aşamaz.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak tanıklık, kesinleşmeme ile zayıf belirtiden doğan ve kuruntuya yaklaşabilen inanışı birlikte gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kuşku ile kuruntu arasındaki, kesin bilgiye ulaşmamış genel zihinsel tutumu anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Zayıf belirtiyi, kesinleşmemeyi ve inanış niteliğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şey kesin bilinmeden onun öyle olduğuna inanılan sıradan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kesinleşmemiş inanışı doğal bir eylem anlatımıyla korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dayanak çok zayıflayıp düşünce kuruntu düzeyine indiğinde kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi suçlama adını, suçlanan kişiyi ve bir kişiyi suçlu saymayı bildiren eylem kullanımlarını birlikte ve açıkça verir. Dal çerçevesi, kişi üzerine suç ya da kusur yükleme çekirdeğini doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal kötü düşünme alışkanlığından, genel kuşkudan ve güçsüzlük bildiren eş sesli kullanımdan ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ad ve sıfat biçimlerindeki yalın suçlama alanını, kişiyle kurulan belirli eylem yapılarından ayrı fakat aynı çekirdeğe bağlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi bir suç ya da kusurla ilişkilendirip onu suçlu sayma, bu suçlamanın kendisi veya suçlanan kişidir. Eylem anlamı, kişiyi nesne ya da ilgeçli tümleç yapan belirli yapılarda gerçekleşir.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye suç veya kusur yükleyerek onu suçlu saymayı anlatır.
Ad ve sıfat biçimleri suçlamanın kendisini ve suçlanan kişiyi belirtir.
Belirli eylem yapıları bir kişiyi doğrudan suçlamak anlamını taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak tanıklık, suçlama, suçlanan kişi ve birini suçlu sayan eylem kullanımlarını aynı çekirdekte birleştirir.

Belirli bağlı yapılar kötü düşüncenin yöneldiği kişiyi veya kötülük içeriğini belirtir.

Güven vermeyen bilgi ve sonucu kestirilemeyen iş de aynı nitelikle anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, hurma ağacının iç yumuşak kısmını ve ağaçların yumuşak iç ya da kök kısımlarını verir; ayrıca hurma ağacının bu iç kısmını çıkarma fiilini de aynı parça üzerinden anar. Dal tutulabilir, fakat çıkarma eylemi genel bir çevirme anlamı değil, bu iç parçayı alma işlemine bağlı yan kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dış yaprakları, genel ağaç gövdesini ve nesne çevirme fiilini kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal olarak tanım, bitkinin yumuşak iç kısmına odaklanır; çıkarma fiili bu parçaya bağlı yan açıklama olarak kalır.

concept_map.definition: Hurma ağacının ortasındaki beyaz ve yumuşak iç sürgün ile ağaçların veya taze bitkilerin yumuşak iç kısımlarıdır. Bu dalda anılan çıkarma eylemi, sadece o iç kısmın alınmasına bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Hurma ağacının ortasında bulunan yumuşak ve beyaz iç kısımdır.
Ağaçların, köklerin, iç boşlukların veya taze bitkilerin yumuşak iç kısımlarına genişler.
Hurma ağacının bu iç kısmını çıkarma eylemi aynı parçaya bağlı olarak anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, hurma ağacının iç yumuşak kısmı ile ağaç ve taze bitkilerin benzer iç yumuşak parçalarını bir arada verir; çıkarma fiili ise bu parçanın alınmasıyla sınırlıdır.

error_profile.loses: Ağaç kökleri, iç boşluklar ve taze bitkilerin yumuşak iç kısımlarına genişlemeyi tam kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir nesneyi yüzünden ya da yönünden başka yöne çevirmeyi, altüst etmeyi, bir kişiyi istediği yönden saptırmayı ve işleri düşünerek evirip çevirmeyi aynı dönüştürme çekirdeğine bağlar. Tamlama bağlı kullanımlar bu çekirdeğin özel uygulamalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yürek organı, öz anlamı, kuyu ve akıbet anlamından ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın çevirme çekirdeğini, kişi saptırma ve işleri düşünme gibi tamlama bağlı kullanımlardan ayrı gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bulunduğu yüzden veya yönden başka yüze, başka yöne ya da ters duruma çevirmek; kişiyi hedeflediği yönden saptırmak ve işleri zihinde evirip çevirerek değerlendirmek anlamıdır.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi yüzünden başka yüze çevirmek, ters çevirmek veya altüst etmektir.
Bir kişiyi yöneldiği taraftan çevirmek veya saptırmak anlamına genişler.
İşleri yönetmek ve üzerinde düşünüp taşınmak için zihinde evirip çevirmek de bu alana bağlıdır.
Ekmek, göz, toprak aleti, renk sapması ve satın alınan kişiyi inceleme gibi özel örnekler aynı çevirmeye dayanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, yön ya da yüz değiştirme çekirdeğini verir; kişi saptırma, işleri düşünme ve somut örnekler bu çekirdeğin özel kullanımlarıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Yüzden yüze çevirme, yön değiştirme ve saptırma çekirdeğini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dönüp ayrılma ve geri dönme anlamındaki isimleşmiş kullanımı, ayrıca varılacak yer, sonuç ve ahirete yönelen akıbet anlamını verir. Bu dal çevirme işlemini değil, yön değişiminin dönüş, varış ve sonuç tarafını anlatır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal el ile nesne çevirmeyi ve yürek organını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, dönüş ve ayrılma kullanımıyla isimleşmiş varış yeri veya akıbet kullanımını birbirinden ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerden ya da durumdan dönüp ayrılma, geri dönme ve sonunda varılan yer veya akıbet anlamıdır. İsim kullanımında hem varış yeri hem de dönüş ya da sonuç olayı anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: Bir yerden veya durumdan dönme, ayrılma ya da geri yönelmedir.
İsim olarak varılan yer, dönüş yeri, sonuç veya akıbet anlamına gelir.
Öğretmenin çocukları evlerine geri göndermesi bu dönüş yönünü somutlaştırır.

root_profile.summary: Bu kökün dalları yürek ve iç merkez, öz ve seçkin kısım, bitki içi, çevirme, dönüş ve akıbet, pişmanlık hareketi, kuyu, takı, beyaz yılan, yıldız adı, hastalık, dudak biçimi, kurt adı, biçim verme kabı, kızaran ham hurma ve yüreğe isabet eylemi gibi birbirinden ayrılmış anlam alanları oluşturur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ortak çekirdeği bir varlığı harekete geçirip göndermek ya da elde tutmayı bırakıp salmak olarak kurar. İnsan, elçi, rüzgar, yağmur ve başka güçler bu işlemin farklı nesneleridir; bunlar ayrı birer çekirdek anlam değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gönderme ve serbest bırakmayı kapsar; yalnızca yavaşlık, süt veya sürü bildiren eşsesli kullanımları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın gönderme ve salıverme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; öteki dallardaki kalıba bağlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanı, canlıyı, doğal gücü ya da başka bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden harekete geçirip bir yöne göndermek; kimi bağlamlarda elde tutmayı bırakıp serbestçe gitmesine izin vermektir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir varlığı durduğu veya tutulduğu konumdan çıkarıp ileri yöneltmektir.
Bir kişi görev veya haber için, rüzgar ve yağmur gibi güçler de etkilerini göstermek üzere gönderilebilir.
Tutmanın karşıtı olarak kullanım, eldeki canlıyı ya da denetlenen gücü salıvermeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, harekete geçirip yollama çekirdeğinde birleşir; görevle gönderme, doğal güçleri yöneltme ve tutulanı serbest bırakma bu çekirdeğin kapsam içi gerçekleşmeleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı dal içinde iki açık gönderim öğesi verir: gönderenin sözünü taşıyan kişi ve taşınan söz ya da haber. Çerçeve bu düzenli kişi-içerik ayrımını doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, haber taşıyıcısı ile taşınan iletiyi kapsar; gönderme eylemini, sürüyü veya kolay yürüyüşü kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalda haber taşıyan kişi ile taşınan içeriği birlikte gösterir; özel kalıplardaki eşsesli anlamlar eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir gönderenin sözünü veya haberini başka birine götüren kişi ya da bu kişinin taşıdığı söz, haber ve iletidir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, bir gönderenden bir alıcıya içerik taşıyan ileti bağını kurar.
Kişi okumasında, taşıyıcı gönderen adına haberleri izleyen ve aktaran görevlidir.
İçerik okumasında sözcük, taşıyıcının götürdüğü sözün veya haberin kendisini belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, gönderici ile alıcı arasındaki aktarımı hem taşıyıcı kişi hem de taşınan söz bakımından kurar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kolay ve zorlamasız ilerleyişi; yumuşak eklem ve bacakları; düz, salık saçı aynı akıcılık niteliği çevresinde toplar. Çerçeve, yürüyüşü tek başına bütün dal saymadan bu ortak niteliği doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, harekette ve uzanışta yumuşak akıcılığı kapsar; gönderme, süt ve ardışık topluluk anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak akıcılık niteliğini verir; yürüyüş, hayvan bacakları, saç ve uzun bacak anlatımları kendi sözcük veya kalıp sınırlarında ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Hareketin zorlamasız, rahat ve akıcı olması ya da bir uzvun veya saçın sertçe kıvrılmadan yumuşakça uzanmasıdır.

facets.statement: Ortak nitelik, direnç ve sertlik göstermeyen rahat bir akış veya uzanıştır.
Yürüyüşte bu nitelik, hayvanı zorlamayan kolay ve akıcı ilerleyiş olarak görünür.
Bacaklar ve eklemler için yumuşaklık, saç için düz ve salık uzanma anlatılır.
Deve topluluğuna uygulandığında hızlı ya da kolayca harekete geçen sürüler kastedilebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kolay yürüyüş, yumuşak eklem ve bacaklar, salık saç ve rahatça ilerleyen deve topluluklarını dirençsiz akıcılık çevresinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yürüyüş, uzuv ve saç gerçekleşmelerini tek bir fiziksel nitelik altında kapsayan kavramsal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kolay ilerleme ile sert olmayan, salık uzanma arasındaki ortak niteliği korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir hayvanın veya topluluğun zorlanmadan ilerlemesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Saçın veya uzuvların yumuşak ve salık oluşunu kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik hali degil; bir soz, haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru kabul etme alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem genel tasdik adlari hem de belirli soz obekleri ve dini kullanislar vardir; tanim bunlari yalin guven anlamina genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali dua icinde soylenen bir kabul istegi sozu ve bu sozu soyleme eylemi olarak verir. Cerceve, guven ve tasdik dallarindan ayrildigi ve sadece dua cevabi formuluyle ilgili oldugu icin uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik ya da tasdik degil; duada kabul talebini bildiren sabit sozdur.

concept_map.definition: Dua sonunda kabul edilme istegini bildiren ve 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' ya da 'bunu yap' anlaminda aciklanan sabit sozdur. Dal ayrica bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve kaynaklarda aktarılan ad yorumunu da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek, duada kabul istegini bildiren sabit cevap sozudur.
Kaynaklar sozun anlamini 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' veya 'bunu yap' seklinde aciklar.
Bu sozu soyleme eylemi de ayni dal icinde adlandirilir.
Bazi aktarimlarda bu sozun ilahi bir ad oldugu yorumu da dalin yan rivayeti olarak bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak dali dua icinde soylenen ve kabul istegi tasiyan sabit bir soz olarak anlatir. Ayni iddia, bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve sozun anlamina dair 'kabul et' ya da 'oyle olsun' aciklamalarini da icerir; ad yorumu ise bu ortak malzemenin yan aktarimidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiye, eve, dine, soya, işe, beldeye ya da ortak yaşama alanına yakınlık ve aidiyet bağıyla bağlı olan insan çevresidir. Eş ve en yakın kişiler çekirdekte durur; ev sakinleri ve ortak bağla birleşen topluluklar bu çekirdeğin genişlemeleridir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, bir kişiyle en yakın ilişki içinde bulunan insan çevresidir.
Evin insanları, o yerde oturan ve eve bağlı sayılan kişiler olarak özel bir kullanımdır.
Din, soy, iş, ev veya belde ortaklığı insanları aynı aidiyet çevresinde toplayabilir.

Ancak tartışmalı türetimde bazı kaynaklar kullanımını reddederken bazıları kabul ettiği için dalın sınırı bu kayıtla belirtilmelidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi veya şeyin belirli bir iş, nitelik ya da karşılık için uygun, yaraşır ve layık konumda olmasıdır. Ayrıca birini böyle bir işe hazır ve uygun duruma getirme ve tartışmalı olarak bir şeyi hak etmiş sayma kullanımı da bu alana bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, bir kişi veya şeyin belli bir işe uygun ve yaraşır olmasıdır.
Takva ve bağışlama için kullanıldığında, gerekli saygı veya bağışlama konumunu belirtir.
Birini bir iş için uygun ve hazır duruma getirme eylemi bu anlamın ettirgen uzantısıdır.
Bir şeyi hak etmiş sayma biçimi bazılarınca reddedilirken başkalarınca kabul edilen tartışmalı kullanımdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yerin sakinli ve dolu olması, canlıların bir yere alışıp evcil veya yerleşik sayılması ve bir kişi ya da yerle yakınlık duygusu kurmayı birlikte verir. Bu çerçeve, mekanın insanla dolu olması ve alışma sonucu yabani olmaktan çıkma ekseninde tutarlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, insan topluluğu adının kendisi değil, yerleşik olma, sakin barındırma ve alışma durumudur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yer tamlamalarını, evcil olma biçimini ve alışma fiilini aynı yerleşiklik alanında ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerin sakinleriyle dolu ve yaşanır olması ya da bir canlının insanlara ve yerleşim yerine alışarak evcil hale gelmesidir. Kişi veya yerle yakınlık duygusu kurma kullanımı da bu alışma ve yabancılık kalkması alanına bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, bir yerin sakinleri bulunan yerleşik ve dolu bir yer olmasıdır.
Bir canlının insanlara ve yerleşim yerine alışması onu evcil veya yerleşik saydırır.
Bir kişi veya şeyle yakınlık duygusu kurup yabancılık çekmemek bu alana bağlı kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalı, yerin sakin barındırması ve dolu olmasıyla başlatır; aynı claim içinde canlıların yer veya insan çevresine alışarak evcil sayılması ve bir şeye yakınlık duygusu duyma kullanımı da verilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem dolu yer hem de insan çevresine alışmış canlı veya yakınlık duyma kullanımını kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Sakin bulunması, alışma ve yerleşiklik çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yer veya konutun içinde yaşayanlar bulunduğu bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sakin bulunan yer anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Canlının evcil hale gelmesi ve yakınlık duyma kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yabani olmayan, insan ve yerleşim çevresine alışmış canlı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan ve yerleşim çevresine alışmış olma anlamını korur.

error_profile.preserves: Alışma ve yabancılığın kalkması anlamını korur.
